title: Lock waits and their root blockers

visibility.description: partial when the role lacks pg_read_all_stats (pg_monitor): pg_stat_activity hides state and xact_start of other roles' sessions; an empty list is then not proof that nothing is blocked or idle in transaction

database.description: The database the connection is in; relation names are resolved in it only

waitTimesUnavailable.description: true on PostgreSQL 13, which has no pg_locks.waitstart: every waitMs is null

maxDepth.description: Deepest chain, null when nothing waits

waiters.description: Every backend waiting for a lock that something blocks, longest wait first; the rows are cut to maxItems in the query

pid.description: Backend pid of the waiting session

datname.description: Database the waiter is connected to

state.description: pg_stat_activity.state of the waiter (null where pg_stat_activity hides it from this role: visibility partial)

waitMs.description: Milliseconds the waiter has waited for the lock (pg_locks.waitstart); null if the wait started and ended while reading, and always null on PostgreSQL 13 (see waitTimesUnavailable)

lockType.description: pg_locks.locktype of the lock waited for: relation, transactionid, tuple, virtualxid...

lockDatabase.description: Name of the database the lock is in; null for a shared object

relationOid.description: OID of the locked relation; null for locks that are not on a relation

relation.description: schema.name of the locked relation; null when the lock is not on a relation, or the relation is in a database other than the connected one (see lockDatabase and relationOid)

depth.description: Hops to a root blocker: 1 when every blocker is a root blocker, else 1 + the deepest waiting blocker

blockedBy.description: pg_blocking_pids of the waiter: sessions holding or queued ahead for a conflicting lock (at most 50); 0 is a prepared transaction, listed in preparedTransactions

blockedByTruncated.description: true when the waiter has more than 50 blockers and blockedBy lists the first 50

items.description: A prepared transaction (PREPARE TRANSACTION): it has no backend and holds its locks until COMMIT PREPARED or ROLLBACK PREPARED

gid.description: The global identifier given to PREPARE TRANSACTION; null when the prepared transaction ended before it could be looked up

preparedTransactions.description: When blockedBy has 0: the prepared transactions that hold a lock on the object the waiter wants (at most 50). The conflict of the lock modes is not checked: one that holds a compatible lock on the same object is listed too

rootBlockerPids.description: Root blockers its chain reaches (at most 50); 0 is a prepared transaction

rootBlockerPidsTruncated.description: true when the chain reaches more than 50 root blockers and rootBlockerPids lists 50 of them

total.description: Entries found before the maxItems cap

omitted.description: Entries left out of items by maxItems

truncated.description: true when items was cut at maxItems

rootBlockers.description: Sessions that block others and are not waiting themselves, most waiters first; a prepared transaction is one entry (pid 0) per gid. The rows are cut to maxItems in the query

pid.description: Backend pid of the root blocker; 0 for a prepared transaction (see preparedTransaction)

datname.description: Database it is connected to (a prepared transaction: the database it ran in)

usename.description: Role it runs as (a prepared transaction: the role that prepared it)

state.description: pg_stat_activity.state; `idle in transaction` is the classic holder (null where pg_stat_activity hides it from this role: visibility partial)

xactAgeMs.description: Milliseconds since its transaction started (xact_start) (null where pg_stat_activity hides it from this role: visibility partial; null for a prepared transaction: see preparedTransaction.prepared)

blockedWaiters.description: Waiting sessions whose chain reaches this root blocker

preparedTransaction.description: Set when this root blocker is a prepared transaction (pid 0), null for a session. Its gid is null only when the transaction ended between the two reads

gid.description: The global identifier given to PREPARE TRANSACTION; null when the prepared transaction ended before it could be looked up

total.description: Entries found before the maxItems cap

omitted.description: Entries left out of items by maxItems

truncated.description: true when items was cut at maxItems
